AisyaRescue.start_zh: 来到格鲁德小镇珠宝店找玛卡拉，
AisyaRescue.start_en: Speak with Cara at the Starlight Memories jewelry shop in Gerudo Town.
AisyaRescue.note_zh: 米尼塔尼高神庙右侧打败莫尔德拉吉克就能见到珠宝店老板
AisyaRescue.note_en: Head to the Toruma Dunes west of Gerudo Town. Defeat the Molduga near the rock outcrop where Isha is stranded, then talk to her to guide her to safety.
reward_zh: 后续找到艾夏还有奖励
reward_en: Crafting services for Scimitar of the Seven and Daybreaker

AmberCollector.start_zh: 走到山脚会遇到两鼓隆族，对话时会自动触发
AmberCollector.start_en: Approach the two Gorons arguing near the path at the foot of Goron City to trigger the conversation.
AmberCollector.note_zh: 没啥注意的，过一下对话就没了
AmberCollector.note_en: Talk to Ramella the Gerudo ore merchant after resolving the dispute. She offers to buy amber in bulk (10 pieces for 200 Rupees).
reward_en: Bulk ore purchasing unlocked (10 Amber for 200 Rupees)

ArrowMeister_Momo.start_zh: 桃虹想到了需使用冷气果的新点子。但是桃虹手上并没有关键的
ArrowMeister_Momo.start_en: Talk to Molli at Rito Village. She has an idea for crafting ice arrows but needs an Ice Fruit.
ArrowMeister_Momo.note_en: Hand an Ice Fruit over to Molli. She will gladly reward you with a bundle of arrows.

Big_Rotate.start_zh: 到森林里面找到卡拉赛对话
Big_Rotate.start_en: Talk to Kula inside the Great Deku Tree's navel in Korok Forest.
Big_Rotate.note_zh: 这个可以先拍张漩涡的照片，再回姆萨诺齐拉神庙交任务
Big_Rotate.note_en: Take a picture of any large whirlpool (such as Lake Hylia's whirlpool or the one in East Reservoir Lake) and show the photo to Kula.

BuildHouse.start_zh: 在一始村建筑店找到帕伍达，
BuildHouse.start_en: Speak with Rhondson at the Hudson Construction office in Tarrey Town after completing 'Mattison's Independence'.
BuildHouse.note_zh: 拉希塔奇瓦卡神庙附近找到古拉内达。另外需要1500卢比
BuildHouse.note_en: Purchase a plot of land from Rhondson for 1,500 Rupees, then travel to the designated build site southeast of Tarrey Town and speak to Grantéson to arrange your dream home.

BuildingMaterialsTutorial.start_en: Talk to Lester and Karson at the unfinished stable in Lookout Landing.
BuildingMaterialsTutorial.note_en: Use Ultrahand to pick up the wooden board and fit it neatly onto the missing section of the stable roof.

CDungeon_AllDone.start_zh: 巡遍所有破魔神庙，在最后一座神庙的最深处传来了劳鲁的声音。前往时之神殿的话，他似乎就会将某物传授给你……
CDungeon_AllDone.start_en: Upon completing all 152 Shrines of Light, Rauru's voice speaks to you at the final shrine, inviting you to the Temple of Time.
CDungeon_AllDone.note_en: Travel to the Temple of Time on the Great Sky Island and open the treasure chest behind the goddess statue.

CarryGoronKid1.start_zh: 少年科普思正在寻找相传古代鼓隆族居住的都市
CarryGoronKid1.start_en: Speak with the young Goron Kopsha near Goron City. He is searching for the legendary ancient city of Gorondia.
CarryGoronKid1.note_en: Place a mine cart on the track, attach a Fan, and transport Kopsha along the rails to the designated tunnel.
CarryGoronKid1.deliver_en: Transport the young Goron safely to the opposite shore.

CarryGoronKid2.name_zh: 发现古代都市鼓隆提亚！？
CarryGoronKid2.start_zh: 完成前置任务后继续找到科普思对话
CarryGoronKid2.start_en: After completing 'The Ancient City Gorondia!', talk to Kopsha again at the tunnel entrance.
CarryGoronKid2.note_zh: 直接用究极手清理巨石就完了
CarryGoronKid2.note_en: Use Ultrahand or a hammer weapon to clear away the giant boulders blocking the tunnel so Kopsha can proceed.

CarryStone.start_en: Speak with Ledo at Zora's Domain near Mipha Court.
CarryStone.note_zh: 旁边就有材料，自己组装一艘船就行，找个石材回来给他
CarryStone.note_en: Assemble a raft using the nearby Zonai devices, cross the reservoir to the cave to collect the glowing blue stone, and transport it safely back to Ledo.

Circuit_Ichikara.name_en: The Tarrey Town Race Is On!
Circuit_Ichikara.start_zh: 找到悉伊达聊天开启任务，
Circuit_Ichikara.start_en: Talk to Fern at the Torin Wetland race track near Tarrey Town.
Circuit_Ichikara.note_zh: 开一圈就完了，没啥技巧
Circuit_Ichikara.note_en: Steer the prototype steering vehicle around the marked track and drive through all the checkpoints within the allotted time.

Connect_AkkareMaze.start_zh: 跟随遗迹前的石碑和笔记探索遗迹
Connect_AkkareMaze.start_en: Interact with the stone tablet at the entrance of the Lomei Labyrinth Island in Akkala.
Connect_AkkareMaze.note_en: Follow the trail of acorns and nuts through the surface maze to reach the shrine. Next, glide through the sky labyrinth activating all four terminals, then dive into the Depths labyrinth and defeat the Flux Construct III.

Connect_GerudoMaze.start_zh: 根据遗迹门口石碑与笔记的内容进入遗迹探索
Connect_GerudoMaze.start_en: Interact with the stone tablet and read the researcher's notebook at the South Lomei Labyrinth.
Connect_GerudoMaze.note_en: Navigate the surface labyrinth by following the acorn trail. Clear the sky labyrinth terminals, then dive straight down into the Depths beneath to conquer the Flux Construct III.

Connect_TabantaMaze.start_zh: 跟随石碑与笔记内容探索遗迹
Connect_TabantaMaze.start_en: Interact with the stone tablet at the entrance of the North Lomei Labyrinth in the Tabantha Tundra.
Connect_TabantaMaze.note_en: Follow the acorn trail to navigate the surface maze. Ascend to the North Lomei Sky Labyrinth to trigger the terminals, then drop down into the Depths and defeat the Flux Construct III.

CookAtBaseCamp.start_zh: 找到波侬，他会因为菜单缺少材料而苦恼
CookAtBaseCamp.start_en: Talk to Burmano near the cooking pot in the emergency shelter at Lookout Landing.
CookAtBaseCamp.note_en: Provide Burmano with an Apple so he can complete his Fruit and Mushroom Mix dish.
reward_zh: 后续也可以模仿做出该菜肴

CreateArmor.start_zh: 前置任务完成后，去找优娜对话获得
CreateArmor.start_en: After completing 'Sidon of the Zora', speak with Lady Yona in Zora's Domain.
CreateArmor.note_zh: 去伊黑恩阿神庙背后，直接跳进东部储水湖的漩涡，一路走到古代卓拉祭殿，底部有一处宝箱，开启即可
CreateArmor.note_en: Dive into the whirlpool at East Reservoir Lake behind the Ihen-a Shrine to enter the Ancient Zora Waterworks. Head to the lowest chamber and open the treasure chest behind the waterfall.

Createshinguard.start_zh: 前置任务完成后与优娜对话，得知伊姆与希弥富去找卓拉头盔了，在王座间与他们对话时触发任务
Createshinguard.start_en: After completing 'Sidon of the Zora', speak with Yona, then talk to Dunma and Cleff in the Zora Throne Room.
Createshinguard.note_zh: 去鱼鳞飞舞之岛，中部有个小洞窟，里面宝箱完成任务
Createshinguard.note_en: Ascend to Floating Scales Island in the sky. Look along the side of the fish-shaped island for a hidden entrance leading to a cave, and open the chest inside.

DefeatHugeEnemy_1.start_zh: 从监视堡垒讨伐队本部的谷拉廉斯那里听取了情报。据他所述，讨伐队在阿卡莱地区的北阿卡莱高地发现了岩石块一般的巨大怪物
DefeatHugeEnemy_1.start_en: Speak with Gralens in the emergency shelter at Lookout Landing to receive monster bounty intel.
DefeatHugeEnemy_1.note_en: Travel to the North Akkala Foothill, locate and eliminate the Stone Talus, then report back to Gralens.

DefeatHugeEnemy_2.start_zh: 从监视堡垒讨伐队本部的谷拉廉斯那里听取了情报。据他所述，调查队在格鲁德沙漠的东格鲁德发现了如鱼一般游动的巨大怪物
DefeatHugeEnemy_2.start_en: Speak with Gralens in the emergency shelter at Lookout Landing to receive monster bounty intel.
DefeatHugeEnemy_2.note_en: Travel to East Gerudo in the Gerudo Desert, locate and slay the Molduga, and report back to Gralens.

DefeatHugeEnemy_3.start_zh: 从监视堡垒讨伐队本部的谷拉廉斯那里听取了情报。据他所述，在海拉鲁平原东北边的森林驿站
DefeatHugeEnemy_3.start_en: Speak with Gralens in the emergency shelter at Lookout Landing to receive monster bounty intel.
DefeatHugeEnemy_3.note_en: Travel to the forest area near Woodland Stable northeast of Hyrule Field, defeat the Hinox, and return to report to Gralens.

DefeatHugeEnemy_4.start_zh: 与谷拉廉斯对话了解怪物情报
DefeatHugeEnemy_4.start_en: Speak with Gralens in the Lookout Landing shelter after completing the initial WANTED bounties.
DefeatHugeEnemy_4.note_en: Travel to the designated sky island (such as West Hebra Sky Archipelago), defeat the Flux Construct, and report back to Gralens.

DefeatHugeEnemy_5.start_zh: 与谷拉廉斯对话了解怪物情报
DefeatHugeEnemy_5.start_en: Speak with Gralens in the Lookout Landing shelter after completing the initial WANTED bounties.
DefeatHugeEnemy_5.note_en: Travel to the Bridge of Hylia (or the specified location), defeat the three-headed Flame Gleeok, and report back to Gralens.

DefeatHugeEnemy_6.start_zh: 与谷拉廉斯对话了解怪物情报
DefeatHugeEnemy_6.start_en: Speak with Gralens in the Lookout Landing shelter after completing the initial WANTED bounties.
DefeatHugeEnemy_6.note_en: Descend into the Depths, locate and defeat the giant Frox lurking in the shadows, then report back to Gralens.

EightHeroStatues.start_zh: 找到罗汀，听他说完和英雄有关的事，然后去寻找石碑
EightHeroStatues.start_en: Speak with Rotana in the Gerudo Town shelter to learn about the ancient heroines.
EightHeroStatues.note_zh: 把找到的石碑拍成照片即可
EightHeroStatues.note_en: Explore the underground shelter and ruins to find and photograph all four ancient stelae (steles), then show the photos to Rotana.

EightHeroStatues_After.start_zh: 完成前置任务后找到罗汀问他石碑的内容触发
EightHeroStatues_After.start_en: After completing 'The Heroines' Secret', speak with Rotana about the deciphered stelae.
EightHeroStatues_After.note_zh: 陆续把拿到的珠子放到雕像手上，全部归位以后就会打开隐藏房间 ，再把巨大宝珠搬到北格鲁德遗迹，一路探索到八英雄像的房间
EightHeroStatues_After.note_en: Collect the seven orbs scattered across Gerudo Town and match each orb's engraved symbol with the corresponding heroine statue in the room. Once the secret vault opens, transport the massive eighth orb to North Gerudo Ruins to unlock the eighth heroine's sanctuary.

ExcavateFossil1.start_en: Talk to Lune near East Akkala Stable, then meet her at the Eldin Great Skeleton in northern Eldin.
ExcavateFossil1.note_zh: 按顺序解锁，逐个补全化石缺失处即可完成任务
ExcavateFossil1.note_en: Use Ultrahand to pick up the missing eye bone stuck in the skull's socket and fit it correctly into the empty eye socket.

ExcavateFossil2.start_en: After completing 'Eldin's Colossal Fossil', meet Lune inside the Hebra Great Skeleton Cave in Hebra.
ExcavateFossil2.note_zh: 按顺序解锁，逐个补全化石缺失处即可完成任务
ExcavateFossil2.note_en: Melt the ice blocks trapping the fossil bones, then assemble and attach the missing spine and tail bones to the skeleton.

ExcavateFossil3.start_en: After completing 'Hebra's Colossal Fossil', meet Lune at the Gerudo Great Skeleton in southwestern Gerudo Desert.
ExcavateFossil3.note_zh: 按顺序解锁，逐个补全化石缺失处即可完成任务
ExcavateFossil3.note_en: Blow away sand piles and dig out the baby leviathan fossil bones, then use Ultrahand to reassemble the complete juvenile skeleton next to the mother.

FindSunaNui.start_zh: 来到格鲁德小镇找到缇克尔来和他进行一场比试
FindSunaNui.start_en: Talk to Dalia in the Gerudo Town shelter before she heads to class in the morning.
FindSunaNui.note_zh:
尽量早点去，在早上他还没上课的时候就去找他
        谜题答案一共有三种
       藏布偶：1.士兵行李边  2.通向洞窟的路上 3.床边
FindSunaNui.note_en: Search for Dalia's Sand Seal plush within 90 seconds. Common hiding spots: next to the soldier's luggage, along the path leading to the cave, or beside the beds.

FindWhiteHorse.start_en: Talk to Lester at the Lookout Landing mini-stable after repairing the roof.
FindWhiteHorse.note_zh: 找到斑点马驯服后骑回来
FindWhiteHorse.note_en: Head southwest into the plains to find Spot, the distinctive white horse with grey spots. Sneak up, soothe it, and ride it back to Lester.

FullyRipenedFlintstones.name_zh: 一石千金！？完全成熟打火石！
FullyRipenedFlintstones.start_en: Speak with Atisen at the Bedrock Bistro in Eldin.
FullyRipenedFlintstones.note_en: Hand over bundles of at least 20 pieces of Flint at a time for Atisen to inspect until he tastes a fully ripened flint.

GeniusWeapon_Zora.name_zh: 卓拉族的荣誉“光鳞之枪”
GeniusWeapon_Zora.start_zh: 完成前置任务之后和罗司里对话触发任务，去寻找武器材料
GeniusWeapon_Zora.start_en: After completing 'Sidon of the Zora', speak with the master smith Dento in Zora's Domain.
GeniusWeapon_Zora.note_zh: 卓拉之枪在附近营地能找到
GeniusWeapon_Zora.note_en: Gather a Zora Spear, 3 Diamonds, and 5 bundles of Wood, then bring them to Dento to forge the legendary spear.

Genkos_Kitchen.start_en: Talk to Genli inside Rito Village during the blizzard.
Genkos_Kitchen.note_en: Bring Genli a Staminoka Bass so she can cook her specialty meal.

GerudoCanyon_24hEnduranceComparison.name_zh: 火热非凡！忍耐力大比拼！
GerudoCanyon_24hEnduranceComparison.start_en: Speak with Rahm atop the rock pillar in Gerudo Canyon.
GerudoCanyon_24hEnduranceComparison.note_en: Strip down to your underwear and endure the midday desert heat from morning to evening by consuming heat-resistance food/elixirs or standing in the shade.

GerudoCanyon_ColdEnduranceComparison.start_en: After winning the Heat-Endurance contest, speak with Rahm again on the rock pillar.
GerudoCanyon_ColdEnduranceComparison.note_en: Strip down to your underwear and endure the freezing desert night until morning using cold-resistance food or elixirs.

GerudoCanyon_GleeokLiver.start_en: Talk to Malena outside Gerudo Canyon Stable. Her husband is gravely ill.
GerudoCanyon_GleeokLiver.note_zh: 准备好古栗欧克的肝脏
GerudoCanyon_GleeokLiver.note_en: Hunt down and defeat any Gleeok to obtain Gleeok Guts, then deliver them to Malena to cure her husband.

GerudoCanyon_TumbleweedSweep.start_en: Speak with Cheria on the road near Gerudo Canyon Stable.
GerudoCanyon_TumbleweedSweep.note_zh: 用火将风滚草全部烧光
GerudoCanyon_TumbleweedSweep.note_en: Use fire arrows, a torch, or slashing weapons to burn and clear away all the tumbling weeds blocking the pathway.

GerudoDesertTreasure.name_zh: 沉睡于格鲁德沙漠的秘宝
GerudoDesertTreasure.start_zh: 在格鲁德小镇与露珠对话开启
GerudoDesertTreasure.start_en: Speak with Chief Riju in Gerudo Town after completing 'Riju of the Gerudo'.
GerudoDesertTreasure.note_zh: 进入沙漠跟着举剑雕像剑指向的地方前进，找到图示1位置打破进入
GerudoDesertTreasure.note_en: Follow the pointing swords of the statues in the desert to West Barrens, break through the destructible rocks covering the underground cave, and open the treasure chest inside.

Gerudo_UrbosaWeapon.name_zh: 格鲁德族的骄傲“七宝武具”
Gerudo_UrbosaWeapon.start_en: After rescuing Isha in 'The Missing Owner', speak to her at the jewelry shop in Gerudo Town.
Gerudo_UrbosaWeapon.note_en: Bring Isha a Gerudo Scimitar, a Gerudo Shield, 4 Diamonds, and 10 pieces of Flint to craft the legendary Gerudo armaments.

GoneSnowQueen.start_zh: 前职业踩盾滑行家丝莱米下落不明。听说她去寻找踩盾滑行的新赛道，但一直没有回来。据徒弟拉塞尔所说，他的搭档芬正在
GoneSnowQueen.start_en: Talk to Russ at Selmie's Spot in the Hebra Mountains. Selmie went missing while scouting new shield-surfing slopes.
GoneSnowQueen.note_en: Follow the smoke down the slope near Lake Kilsi to find Fin. Enter East Biron Snowshelf Cave and break through the cracked rock wall to find and rescue Selmie.

GoronPond.name_en: The Hidden Treasure at Lizard Lakes
GoronPond.start_zh: 在鼓隆桥中央与布尔多对话开启
GoronPond.start_en: Speak with Boss Bludo on the bridge in Goron City after completing 'Yunobo of the Gorons'.
GoronPond.note_en: Head to the two lizard-shaped lakes north of Death Mountain. Enter Lizard's Burrow cave located between the two lakes and open the chest deep within.

GoronReturntoNature.start_zh: 看到博伊空两个人在谈话，然后凑过去搭话，两个人正在回忆出生时遇见的景象。
GoronReturntoNature.start_en: Talk to the elderly Gorons Volcon and Tray in Goron City discussing a full moon they saw in a cave during their youth.
GoronReturntoNature.note_zh: 点个火把消耗时间，最后拍张照片交任务
GoronReturntoNature.note_en: Head to Lake Ferona Cave around midday (around 12:00 PM). Wait for the sunlight shining through the cave ceiling to reflect on the pool looking like a glowing full moon, take a photo, and show it to them.

Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_01.start_zh: 到南部采矿场深部找到矿工触发任务
Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_01.start_en: Talk to the Goron brother Bayge inside the Southern Mine.
Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_01.note_en: Board the mine cart, hit all 5 target balloons with your bow before reaching the goal, and complete the beginner course.

Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_02.start_zh: 成功通关了阿沅队策划的“矿车乐园”初级赛道后，夕尔邀请你游玩面向中水平玩家的赛道。
Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_02.start_en: After beating the beginner course at Mine-Cart Land, talk to Slergo to unlock the intermediate Quickshot Course.
Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_02.note_en: Ride the mine cart and shoot down at least 7 target balloons with your arrows before crossing the finish line.

Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_03.name_zh: 超高难度的死亡之山赛道！
Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_03.start_zh: 卡贝塔似乎想出了超高难度的矿车赛道，地点就在死亡之山上。卡贝塔只留下了一句“我在
Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_03.start_en: Talk to Bayge after clearing the Quickshot Course to accept his challenge on Death Mountain.
Goron_MiniGame_Tutorial_03.note_en: Climb up to Death Mountain's summit, ride the mine cart on the high-speed rails around the crater, and pop at least 8 targets.

Hack_GuardGoods.start_zh: 哈库在往利特村搬运雪原驿站分来的物资途中，被
Hack_GuardGoods.start_en: Speak with Huck along the road between Snowfield Stable and Rito Village.
Hack_GuardGoods.note_en: Shoot down all the Aerocudas circling overhead that are threatening the supply cart, then talk to Huck.

Hateno_CoolGuy.start_zh: 在白天的时候去哈特诺村一个蘑菇木雕下找到万作来获得任务
Hateno_CoolGuy.start_en: Talk to Manny standing under the giant mushroom sculpture in Hateno Village during the day.
Hateno_CoolGuy.note_zh: 先找到阿伊比询问爱好，再去找万作，最后去哈诺特村的井底收集10个速速蛙找万作完成任务
Hateno_CoolGuy.note_en: Speak with Ivee at the general store to find out what she likes, report back to Manny, then collect 10 Hot-Footed Frogs (found in local wells) and deliver them to him.

Hateno_FreshMilk.start_en: Speak with Dantz at Hateno Pasture in Hateno Village.
Hateno_FreshMilk.note_en: Collect 3 Acorns (by shooting squirrels or chopping trees) and give them to Dantz to trade for milk.

Hateno_NewCostume.start_zh: 在标点附近寻找一个水井，顺着水井到达底部，会发现一处公告台，走到附近阅读赛尔达的日记开启任务
Hateno_NewCostume.start_en: Climb down Zelda's Secret Well behind her house in Hateno Village and read Zelda's Diary on the desk.
Hateno_NewCostume.note_zh: 回到王庭主殿，点燃两处烛台就能开启机关
Hateno_NewCostume.note_en: Head to the Sanctum in Hyrule Castle and light the two unlit torches flanking the royal throne to reveal the hidden compartment holding the chest.

Hateno_NewSpecialty.start_en: Speak with Mayor Reede at his house in Hateno Village.
Hateno_NewSpecialty.note_zh: 将夜间袭击的怪物消灭
Hateno_NewSpecialty.note_en: Protect Reede's pumpkin patch from waves of Skeletal Bokoblins attacking at night until sunrise.

Hateno_TellMeTeacher01.start_zh: 面对不愿相信很久以前的灾难故事的孩子们，西蒙认为只要能给孩子们展示“描绘着灾厄的屏风”的
Hateno_TellMeTeacher01.start_en: Visit the Hateno School during morning class (9:00 AM - 2:00 PM) and speak with the teacher, Symin.
Hateno_TellMeTeacher01.note_en: Travel to Kakariko Village, enter Lady Paya's mansion, take a photo of the ancient Calamity Screen on the second floor, and show it to Symin.

Hateno_TellMeTeacher02.start_zh: 完成前置任务以后，再次与西蒙对话时触发任务
Hateno_TellMeTeacher02.start_en: After completing 'Teach Me a Lesson I', speak to Symin again during class at Hateno School.
Hateno_TellMeTeacher02.note_zh: 按照家政课的安排，把海拉鲁米、怪物精华、鼓隆的调味粉一起烹调处怪物咖喱饭，没有怪物精华的可以在一始村可以和杂货店的人购买，做完了带着去找西蒙
Hateno_TellMeTeacher02.note_en: Cook Monster Curry using Hylian Rice, Goron Spice, and Monster Extract (purchased at Tarrey Town or Kilton's), and deliver the dish to Symin.
reward_zh: 可以自由使用学校的农田
reward_en: Access to Hateno School Garden plot

Hateno_WhatToPlant.start_zh: 完成前置任务后，学校边上的农田和乌梅对话时触发任务
Hateno_WhatToPlant.start_en: Talk to Granny Uma tending the garden field below Hateno School after unlocking the plot.
Hateno_WhatToPlant.note_zh: 选定完作物给完乌梅以后需要等待作物收成，这个收成时间即便在篝火旁消耗时间也不会减少，只能过段时间再回来
Hateno_WhatToPlant.note_en: Select a crop of your choice to plant with Uma. Wait several in-game days (campfire waiting does not count) and return to harvest your grown produce.

Hebra_SkyRingChallenge.name_zh: 利特族的新式飞行训练
Hebra_SkyRingChallenge.start_en: Talk to Kaneli at the Flight Range in the Hebra Mountains.
Hebra_SkyRingChallenge.note_en: Glide and maneuver your paraglider through all the aerial ring targets within the time limit.

HorseInnChallenge001.start_en: Talk to Izum near New Serenne Stable.
HorseInnChallenge001.note_zh: 需要先用究极手修好马车，然后弄一匹马给可姿米
HorseInnChallenge001.note_en: Use Ultrahand to attach two wooden wagon wheels onto the broken wagon frame, then tame and harness a wild horse to hitch to the cart.
HorseInnChallenge001.deliver_zh: 把修好的马车牵回可姿米面前（交付=两件事都完成：装车轮 + 驯服野马）。
HorseInnChallenge001.deliver_en: Bring the repaired and hitched carriage back to Kazumi (attach the wheels and tame a wild horse).

HorseInnChallenge002.start_en: Talk to Ami near the well at Wetland Stable.
HorseInnChallenge002.note_zh: 将井旁的怪物营地清除
HorseInnChallenge002.note_en: Clear out the camp of monsters occupying the area near the stable's well, then report back to Ami.

HorseInnChallenge003.start_en: Speak with Pyper at Dueling Peaks Stable.
HorseInnChallenge003.note_zh: 用前面的机器换一次左纳乌装置
HorseInnChallenge003.note_en: Insert Zonai Charges or Soldier Construct Horns into the nearby Device Dispenser to dispense Zonai capsules.

HorseInnChallenge005.start_en: Talk to Penndara at Riverside Stable.
HorseInnChallenge005.note_zh: 将驿站周围的咕咕鸡抓回鸡圈里
HorseInnChallenge005.note_en: Find and carry back the five escaped Cuccos roaming around the stable grounds and drop them safely into the pen.

HorseInnChallenge007.start_zh: 先找到驿站的康珀，然后分别去三个洞窟打到巨人三兄弟
HorseInnChallenge007.start_en: Talk to Kampo at Lakeside Stable about the three giant Hinox brothers terrorizing nearby caves.
HorseInnChallenge007.note_zh: 打巨人先打头，等坐到地上以后再给他修脚
HorseInnChallenge007.note_en: Visit Corta Lake Cave, Rodai Lakefront Tunnel, and Calora Lake Cave. Defeat the Youngest, Middle, and Oldest Hinox brothers in their respective caves, then report back.

HotSpringEgg.name_zh: 隐秘温泉 岩熔温泉
HotSpringEgg.start_zh: 找到麦萨奇，帮他找到岩熔温泉
HotSpringEgg.start_en: Talk to Megg in Goron City, who is searching for the fabled Simmerstone Springs.
HotSpringEgg.note_zh: 先找珀奇寻找线索，最后逐步推进，最后打开塌方的入口即可
HotSpringEgg.note_en: Speak with Kairo for clues, head to Gorko Tunnel south of Goron City, break through the collapsed rock walls, and uncover the secret hot springs.

HourseInnChallenge004.start_en: Speak with Parcy at Riverside Stable.
HourseInnChallenge004.note_en: Fuse a high-power monster horn or material to a weapon to achieve exceptional striking power, then show the fused weapon to Parcy.

HuntSalmon.start_zh: 在地点附近找到扶丘，与他交谈触发
HuntSalmon.start_en: Speak with Fronk at Zora's Domain. His wife Mei was carried away to the floating sky islands.
HuntSalmon.note_zh: 他老婆在天上空岛，卓拉领地上边那个就是
HuntSalmon.note_en: Travel to Wellspring Island in the sky above Lanayru. Find Mei gazing into a water pool, speak to her, and tell her Fronk is waiting for her back home.

IchikaraCircuit_Tutorial.name_zh: 熟练驾驭左纳乌装置吧
IchikaraCircuit_Tutorial.start_zh: 左纳乌调查队的悉伊达和松达建筑店一起，正在尝试制作使用了左纳乌装置的载具。虽然只要找到
IchikaraCircuit_Tutorial.start_en: Talk to Fern of the Zonai Survey Team at the Tarrey Town construction grounds.
IchikaraCircuit_Tutorial.note_en: Attach a Steering Stick to the prototype wheeled vehicle, hop on, and drive it through all the course gates within the time limit.

IllnessStartsWithFeelings.start_zh: 在一个棚子底下找到 拉兹莉对话后领取任务
IllnessStartsWithFeelings.start_en: Talk to Lasli sitting beneath the canopy in Kakariko Village. Her grandmother is suffering from Gloom sickness.
IllnessStartsWithFeelings.note_zh: 使用海拉鲁米、鲜牛奶、向阳草烹饪，做出灿烂野菜牛奶粥交给拉兹莉完成任务
IllnessStartsWithFeelings.note_en: Cook Sunny Veggie Porridge using Hylian Rice, Fresh Milk, and a Sundelion, then feed the remedy to the sick grandmother.
reward_en: Claree's shop prices restored to normal

InnNeverReturns.start_zh: 需要先去卡卡立科村的旅馆找前台聊天接到任务
InnNeverReturns.start_en: Speak with Dai at the inn counter in Kakariko Village.
InnNeverReturns.note_zh: 前往哈格罗莫湖上方的遗迹找到睡在石板上的旅馆老板，从旁边的人口中得知只有用生命松露才能让他起来，这个材料在村子东侧瀑布上隐藏的洞窟里可以采集，最后回到旅馆交接
InnNeverReturns.note_en: Find the sleeping innkeeper resting on a stone slab inside the ruins above Lantern Lake. Feed him a Hearty Truffle (found in the hidden waterfall cave east of the village) to wake him, then return to the inn.

JobSunazarashi.start_zh: 在小镇出租海象店会见到店主与人交谈，听完后分别和两人对话触发，要找到两个巨大雕像对望地点
JobSunazarashi.start_en: Speak with Pokte at the Sand Seal rental shop in Gerudo Town. A traveler wants to visit the two facing hero statues.
JobSunazarashi.note_zh: 地点在图片有，悬停处即是
JobSunazarashi.note_en: Hitch a sled to a Sand Seal and escort Pokte across the desert dunes to the designated East Barrens ruins where two giant statues face each other.

Know_FourStonePlates.start_en: Speak with Bugut at Kakariko Village as he wanders admiring the Ring Ruins.
Know_FourStonePlates.note_zh:
首先需要前往4座环卡遗迹区去查看解读的石板内容。
4座遗迹分别在哈格罗莫湖上方、纳利夏高地西侧、卡卡利科村南侧、东部高台，地图上能看到明显的圆环形地区
全部遗迹的石板都解读后回去找布古力聊天
Know_FourStonePlates.note_en: Visit and read the deciphered stone slabs at all four accessible Ring Ruins surrounding Kakariko Village, then report back to Bugut.

KokkoGuidePost.start_zh: 原料店正式开张后，找西陀拉接取任务。
KokkoGuidePost.start_en: Talk to Trissa at High Spirits Produce in Kakariko Village after completing the prerequisite quests.
KokkoGuidePost.note_zh: 提前准备好10禽蛋给她即可
KokkoGuidePost.note_en: Follow the morning Cuccos up into the hidden cliffside coop, gather 10 Bird Eggs, and deliver them to Trissa.

Lodge_Chemical001.start_en: Interact with the locked cabin door in the Tabantha Hills.
Lodge_Chemical001.note_en: Defeat all the monsters surrounding the outside of the cabin, then knock on the door again to let the trapped traveler out.

Mack_SecretBase.name_zh: 德库树长老是秘密基地？
Mack_SecretBase.start_zh: 先用通天术从树洞上去找到拓奇，对话后帮他收集材料完善秘密基地
Mack_SecretBase.start_en: Use Ascend inside the Great Deku Tree's stomach to reach the secret upper chamber and talk to the Korok Tasho.
Mack_SecretBase.note_zh: 可以提前准备好4个潜行草，2个光亮花种子
Mack_SecretBase.note_en: Bring Tasho 4 Blue Nightshades and 2 Giant Brightbloom Seeds to illuminate and decorate his secret base.

MakeAChampionsWeapon_Goron.start_zh: 在鼓隆城与呼戈对话时触发，帮他收集完成武器的最后一步所需的材料
MakeAChampionsWeapon_Goron.start_en: After completing 'Yunobo of the Gorons', speak with the smith apprentice Hugo in Goron City.
MakeAChampionsWeapon_Goron.note_zh: 可以提前准备1把劈石剑、5个打火石与3个钻石给他
MakeAChampionsWeapon_Goron.note_en: Gather a Cobble Crusher, 5 pieces of Flint, and 3 Diamonds, then deliver them to Hugo to forge the legendary weapon.

MakeChemicalWeapon.start_zh: 到卡拉卡拉集市找到布洛武，他正在为往武器上装什么而苦恼
MakeChemicalWeapon.start_en: Talk to Boraunt at Kara Kara Bazaar, who is struggling to impress his beloved with weapon decoration.
MakeChemicalWeapon.note_zh: 用余料建造给武器装上红宝石，必须是红宝石，但是武器没有要求
MakeChemicalWeapon.note_en: Fuse a Ruby to any weapon in your inventory and show the glowing, fiery weapon to Boraunt.

MeatRock.name_zh: 果然还是要里脊岩鼓咯
MeatRock.start_zh: 找到烧烤摊的巴尔达斯开启任务
MeatRock.start_en: Speak with Chef Baldas at the Bedrock Bistro grill in Eldin.
MeatRock.note_zh: 沿着铁轨找到餐厅东部的坑道，采集一些里脊岩
MeatRock.note_en: Follow the mine cart tracks east to the Bistro Eastern Tunnel cave, carry a piece of Rock Roast back, and deliver it to Baldas.
MeatRock.deliver_zh: 把里脊岩交给主厨巴尔达斯。
MeatRock.deliver_en: Deliver the Roast Rock to Chef Bardas.

MessageBottle_SOS.start_zh: 海边有个瓶子，里面有个瓶中信
MessageBottle_SOS.start_en: Examine the bottled message washed ashore at Hateno Beach.
MessageBottle_SOS.note_zh: 自己做一艘船到卡艾德半岛的洞窟，洞窟有一处角落有一个石头，用究极手移走后会发现一处洞窟，里面可以救出秋明
MessageBottle_SOS.note_en: Sail a boat into the sea cave at Cape Cresia. Clear away the large boulder blocking the small inner opening with Ultrahand to rescue Choumin.

MushroomSisters_1.start_zh: 在塔玛湖南边与娜茨&玫古姐妹对话之后
MushroomSisters_1.start_en: Talk to the sisters Nat and Meghyn outside Brightcap Cave south of Tama Pond.
MushroomSisters_1.note_zh: 需要进入洞窟寻找10个光亮蘑菇
MushroomSisters_1.note_en: Venture inside Brightcap Cave, harvest 10 Brightcaps, and bring them back to the sisters.
reward_zh: 后续会在北方地区继续遇见这两姐妹
reward_en: Sister encounters continue in northern regions

MushroomSisters_2.start_en: Speak with Nat and Meghyn outside their invaded campsite near Snowfield Stable.
MushroomSisters_2.note_zh: 将照亮洞穴的蘑菇完成即可
MushroomSisters_2.note_en: Defeat all the Bokoblins occupying the sisters' campsite tent, then speak with Nat to return their gear.

MushroomSisters_3.start_en: After completing 'The Captured Tent', talk to Nat and Meghyn near the Hebra Mountains.
MushroomSisters_3.note_zh: 来到库姆的源头洞窟深入
MushroomSisters_3.note_en: Explore deep into the Sturnida Springs Cave, discover the hidden Mushroom Haven cavern, and talk to the sisters inside.

Nazley_DigCave.start_en: Talk to Nazli standing outside a collapsed cave in Rospro Pass.
Nazley_DigCave.note_en: Use bomb flowers or a heavy rock hammer to smash through all the dense cracked rock layers blocking the cave entrance.

Neck_IceWaterCave.start_en: Speak with Verfa inside the freezing cavern in the Hebra Mountains.
Neck_IceWaterCave.note_en: Build a bridge with logs or fuse ice slabs across the freezing water to reach the ten Chillshrooms on the far ledge, then bring them back.

NewCanyonMissingPersonsCase.start_zh: 找到默括，他和一起探险的伙伴走散了，需要找到他的伙伴
NewCanyonMissingPersonsCase.start_en: Talk to Quince outside Gerudo Canyon Stable. His four expedition companions are missing across the canyon.
NewCanyonMissingPersonsCase.note_zh: 第一个人需要水之果，第二个需要暖暖草果，第三个在斯塔而里台地的洞窟，需要打败周围的蜥蜴怪物
NewCanyonMissingPersonsCase.note_en: Rescue all four lost travelers: give Splash Fruit to the dehydrated one, Spicy Pepper to the freezing one, defeat the Lizalfos guarding the third inside Stalry Plateau Cave, and help the fourth near the road.

NowInTheVillageOfLurelin.start_en: Speak with Village Head Rozel and Bolson on the ridge overlooking Lurelin Village.
NowInTheVillageOfLurelin.note_en: Descend into Lurelin Village and eradicate every single monster, including the pirate ship crew and the monster hiding down the village well.

Our_Treasure.start_en: Speak with Domidak and Prissen near the bog in the Dueling Peaks region.
Our_Treasure.note_zh: 用究极手将宝箱挪出即可
Our_Treasure.note_en: Use Ultrahand to lift the sunken treasure chest out of the muddy bog and set it on solid ground for the brothers.

Parasail_ChuchuDesign.start_zh: 在哈特诺村染坊接取任务。
Parasail_ChuchuDesign.start_en: Speak with Sayge at the Kochi Dye Shop in Hateno Village.
Parasail_ChuchuDesign.note_zh: 到哈特诺村北边的井底，拍摄丘丘的照片给瑟吉看完成任务。
Parasail_ChuchuDesign.note_en: Snap a photo of any standard Chuchu (found in local fields or Hateno Village East Well) using your Camera rune, and present the picture to Sayge.
reward_zh: 第一次交流可以拿到SAGONO的布料
完成任务以后拿到丘丘的布料

PhotoSpot_Challenge_01.name_zh: 装点新玛丽塔驿站的画作
PhotoSpot_Challenge_01.name_en: A Picture for New Serenne Stable
PhotoSpot_Challenge_01.start_zh: 在新玛丽塔驿站中调查空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_01.start_en: Examine the blank wooden picture frame on the wall inside New Serenne Stable.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_01.note_zh:
在北海拉鲁平原空地图案处上方拍摄“地上图画”
需要热气球等其他物品升空，从空中向地下拍摄
PhotoSpot_Challenge_01.note_en: Launch into the sky using the Lindor's Brow Skyview Tower or a Hot-Air Balloon, snap a clear photo of the Geoglyph on North Hyrule Plain from above, and show it to the stablemaster.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_02.start_zh: 在森林驿站中调查空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_02.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside Woodland Stable to talk with the stablemaster Kish.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_02.note_zh: 在鼓隆城中的温泉处拍摄泡温泉的鼓隆族
PhotoSpot_Challenge_02.note_en: Travel to Goron City, snap a photo of a Goron soaking happily in the Goron Hot Springs, and show the photograph to Kish.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_03.start_zh: 在湿地驿站中调查空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_03.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside Wetland Stable to speak with Lawun.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_03.note_zh: 在卡卡利特村旁的山顶拍摄“环卡遗迹”
PhotoSpot_Challenge_03.note_en: Climb the hill behind Kakariko Village to snap a photo of the lantern-lit Ring Ruins, then deliver the photo to Lawun.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_04.name_zh: 装点平原外围的驿站的画作
PhotoSpot_Challenge_04.start_zh: 在平原外围的驿站中互动空画框开启
PhotoSpot_Challenge_04.start_en: Examine the blank frame on the wall inside Outskirt Stable.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_04.note_zh: 在萨托利山山顶拍摄“樱花”
PhotoSpot_Challenge_04.note_en: Travel to the summit of Satori Mountain, take a scenic photograph of the glowing Cherry Blossom Tree in full bloom, and show it to the stablemaster.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_05.start_zh: 在河畔驿站中调查空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_05.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside Riverside Stable.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_05.note_zh: 在初始空岛时之神殿中拍摄“时之神殿的大女神像”
PhotoSpot_Challenge_05.note_en: Ascend to the Temple of Time on the Great Sky Island, photograph the Great Goddess Statue inside the hall, and show the picture to the stablemaster.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_06.name_en: A Picture for Dueling Peaks Stable
PhotoSpot_Challenge_06.start_zh: 在双子驿站中调查空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_06.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside Dueling Peaks Stable.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_06.note_zh: 清晨在卡尔山山顶拍摄“海拉鲁最美朝阳”
PhotoSpot_Challenge_06.note_en: Climb to the summit of Tuft Mountain at daybreak (between 4:00 AM and 6:00 AM), take a photo of the sunrise over the Necluda Sea, and deliver it to the stablemaster.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_07.name_zh: 装点塔邦挞大桥驿站的画作
PhotoSpot_Challenge_07.name_en: A Picture for Tabantha Bridge Stable
PhotoSpot_Challenge_07.start_zh: 在塔邦挞大桥驿站中调查空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_07.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside Tabantha Bridge Stable to speak with Dabi.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_07.note_zh: 早晨时在路茨平原的古代石柱群处拍摄“古代石柱群与日出”
PhotoSpot_Challenge_07.note_en: Visit the Ancient Columns on the Rayne Highlands at sunrise, snap a photograph of the morning sun rising behind the pillars, and show it to Dabi.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_08.start_zh: 在山麓驿站中调查空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_08.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside Foothill Stable to speak with Oz.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_08.note_zh: 在马拉克古奇神庙前拍摄“达尔克尔像”
PhotoSpot_Challenge_08.note_en: Head to Goron City near Marakuguc Shrine, snap a photo of the carved monument of Champion Daruk, and show it to Oz.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_09.name_en: A Picture for the Closed Stable I
PhotoSpot_Challenge_09.start_zh: 在格鲁德峡谷驿站中调查空画框进入对话（有两个画框）
PhotoSpot_Challenge_09.start_en: Examine the first blank picture frame inside Gerudo Canyon Stable to speak with Piaffe.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_09.note_zh:
画作1：在东格鲁德天空诸岛（下方图示1位置）向下方拍摄“微笑眼镜岩”
画作2：在格鲁德高地（下方图示3位置）拍摄“被遗忘的剑”
PhotoSpot_Challenge_09.note_en: Fly to East Gerudo Sky Archipelago, look down from the sky island to photograph Spectacle Rock when it appears to smile, and present the photo to Piaffe.
reward_zh:
一份冰冷蘑菇烩饭
画作2：1点驿站点数

PhotoSpot_Challenge_09_2.name_en: A Picture for the Closed Stable II
PhotoSpot_Challenge_09_2.start_zh: 格鲁德峡谷驿站的主人皮阿斐想要一幅据说存在于驿站西北方
PhotoSpot_Challenge_09_2.start_en: Examine the second blank picture frame inside Gerudo Canyon Stable to speak with Piaffe.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_09_2.note_en: Climb to the northern peak of Gerudo Summit, photograph the Forgotten Sword held by the colossal Eighth Heroine statue, and show it to Piaffe.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_10.start_zh: 在湖畔驿站中调查空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_10.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside Lakeside Stable.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_10.note_zh: 晴天时在花柔莉亚桥拍摄“晴天时的花柔莉亚大瀑布”
PhotoSpot_Challenge_10.note_en: Wait for clear weather, stand on Floria Bridge to photograph the majestic Floria Falls in clear sunlight, and deliver the picture to the stablemaster.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_11.start_zh: 在驿站中互动空画框开启
PhotoSpot_Challenge_11.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside Highland Stable.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_11.note_zh: 在马神湖附近拍摄巨身白马
PhotoSpot_Challenge_11.note_en: Head to the Ibara Butte canyon near the Lake of the Horse God, photograph the Giant White Stallion, and bring the picture to the stablemaster.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_12.name_zh: 装点东阿卡莱驿站的画作
PhotoSpot_Challenge_12.name_en: A Picture for East Akkala Stable
PhotoSpot_Challenge_12.start_zh: 在东阿卡莱驿站中查看空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_12.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside East Akkala Stable.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_12.note_zh: 需在下雨天拍摄八爪鱼池塘
PhotoSpot_Challenge_12.note_en: Visit Octo Lake in southern Deep Akkala during rainy weather, take a photo of the octopus-shaped pool in the rain, and show it to the stablemaster.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_13.name_zh: 装点南阿卡莱驿站的画作
PhotoSpot_Challenge_13.name_en: A Picture for South Akkala Stable
PhotoSpot_Challenge_13.start_zh: 在南阿卡莱驿站中调查空画框
PhotoSpot_Challenge_13.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside South Akkala Stable.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_13.note_zh: 在一始村中央拍摄结之钟即可
PhotoSpot_Challenge_13.note_en: Visit the town square of Tarrey Town, photograph the Unity Bell in the center of town, and show the photo to the stablemaster.

PhotoSpot_Challenge_14.start_zh: 在雪原驿站中调查空画框进入对话
PhotoSpot_Challenge_14.start_en: Examine the blank picture frame inside Snowfield Stable to speak with Varke.
PhotoSpot_Challenge_14.note_zh:
在夏利巴山山顶拍摄“振翅于海布拉山脉的巨鸟”
需穿防寒服
PhotoSpot_Challenge_14.note_en: Equip cold-resistant armor, climb to the peak of Talonto Peak on the Hebra Mountains, photograph the giant bird shape formed by the snowy landscape below, and deliver it to Varke.

Raise_GoddesStatue.start_en: Interact with the colossal fallen Mother Goddess Statue at the deepest point of the Forgotten Temple.
Raise_GoddesStatue.note_zh: 需完成前三个女神像任务
Raise_GoddesStatue.note_en: Offer dragon claws to the Goddess Statues of Courage (Farosh), Power (Dinraal), and Wisdom (Naydra), then return to the restored Mother Goddess Statue in the Forgotten Temple.

Raise_GoddesStatue_Courage.start_en: Pray at the Goddess Statue located in the Spring of Courage in the Faron region.
Raise_GoddesStatue_Courage.note_zh: 最好提前准备好费罗龙的爪子，还有就是首次接三女神像任务的时候需要去忘却神像与倒地的母亲女神像互动才能开启任务
Raise_GoddesStatue_Courage.note_en: First inspect the fallen Mother Goddess Statue in Forgotten Temple. Locate Farosh the lightning dragon, shoot its talon to obtain Farosh's Claw, and place the claw in the spring pool as an offering.

Raise_GoddesStatue_Power.start_zh: 在力量之泉中放置奥尔龙的爪子
Raise_GoddesStatue_Power.start_en: Pray at the Goddess Statue located in the Spring of Power in the Akkala region.
Raise_GoddesStatue_Power.note_zh: 提前准备奥尔龙的爪子
Raise_GoddesStatue_Power.note_en: First inspect the fallen Mother Goddess Statue in Forgotten Temple. Shoot the foot of Dinraal the fire dragon to obtain Dinraal's Claw, and drop it into the spring as an offering.

Raise_GoddesStatue_Wisdom.start_en: Pray at the Goddess Statue located in the Spring of Wisdom on Mount Lanayru.
Raise_GoddesStatue_Wisdom.note_zh: 首次接三女神像任务的时候需要去忘却神像与倒地的母亲女神像互动才能开启任务，提前准备好聂尔龙的爪子
Raise_GoddesStatue_Wisdom.note_en: First inspect the fallen Mother Goddess Statue in Forgotten Temple. Shoot the talon of Naydra the ice dragon to obtain Naydra's Claw, and offer it to the spring.

RescueHost.start_zh: 首先需要到格鲁德峡谷驿站找到皮阿斐，然后听他说完自己的烦恼
RescueHost.start_en: Talk to Piaffe inside the clutter-filled Gerudo Canyon Stable.
RescueHost.note_zh: 尽量提前准备几个炸弹花，给箭带上炸弹花会清理的很快
RescueHost.note_en: Use Ultrahand, blunt weapons, or Bomb Flowers to break apart and clear out all the wooden crates and debris blocking the interior of the stable.

RescueVehicle01.start_zh: 矿洞里面找到坐着的莫塔对话
RescueVehicle01.start_en: Speak with Mota sitting stranded deep inside Death Mountain West Site cave.
RescueVehicle01.note_zh: 先用究极手把车移动到轨道，然后让她上车，撞出去就可以了
RescueVehicle01.note_en: Place a mine cart on the rails using Ultrahand, attach a Rocket or Fan, have Mota sit inside, and launch the cart safely out of the cave.
RescueVehicle01.deliver_zh: 把滞留的作业员带出洞窟、带回外面。
RescueVehicle01.deliver_en: Rescue the stranded worker and escort him safely out of the cave.

RescueWell.start_en: Drop down into Rebonae Bridge Well and speak with the stranded traveler Dillie.
RescueWell.note_en: Use Ultrahand to repair the broken ladder pieces or build a makeshift scaffold so Dillie can climb out of the well.

ResearchEldin.start_zh: 餐厅的主厨巴尔达斯对剩饭的本戈感到相当愤慨。看来如果不带来被浪费的食材　，就不会放他回去。据说在
ResearchEldin.start_en: Speak with Chef Baldas and Bohne at the Bedrock Bistro. Baldas demands replacement Marbled Rock Roast before letting Bohne leave.
ResearchEldin.note_en: Head into Restaurant West Cave nearby, find a piece of Marbled Rock Roast, carry it back on a mine cart to the bistro, and deliver it to Baldas.

ResearchLanayru.start_zh: 在标点附近可以看到斯八巴在淤泥里面
ResearchLanayru.start_en: Approach the sludge-covered Zora soldier Subar stuck near Upland Zorana Skyview Tower.
ResearchLanayru.note_zh: 用弓箭附魔“水之果”即可清除淤泥
ResearchLanayru.note_en: Throw a Splash Fruit or shoot a water-fused arrow directly at Subar to wash away the sludge engulfing him.

RestaurantInTheWell.start_zh: 跳入井中与米默扎对话
RestaurantInTheWell.start_en: Drop into the Rikoka Hills Well and speak with the eccentric cook Mimosa.
RestaurantInTheWell.note_en: Prepare any failed or dubious dish (such as Dubious Food or Rock-Hard Food) and hand it to Mimosa to satisfy her craving for bizarre culinary experiments.

RitoBridgeRepair.start_en: Talk to Gesane standing by the severed rope bridge leading into Rito Village.
RitoBridgeRepair.note_zh: 前往监视堡垒与桂达对话
RitoBridgeRepair.note_en: Travel to Lookout Landing to hire the carpenter Karson, then gather 20 bundles of Wood and deliver them to Karson at the bridge to complete the repairs.

Rito_ItemExchange.start_en: Speak with Bela on the wooden walkways of Rito Village after the blizzard has subsided.
Rito_ItemExchange.note_en: Bring 3 Glowing Cave Fish to Bela to exchange them for bundles of arrows.

Rito_MedoArmor.name_zh: 沉睡于山中秘泉的秘宝
Rito_MedoArmor.start_zh: 在利特村找到丘栗对话开启
Rito_MedoArmor.start_en: Speak with Tulin in Rito Village after completing 'Tulin of the Rito'.
Rito_MedoArmor.note_zh: 抵达比隆雪原图示1位置，看到图示2巨大冰块，用火融化后进入洞窟，将洞窟中石块打碎防水开启机关
Rito_MedoArmor.note_en: Head to the Biron Snowshelf in Hebra. Melt the giant ice block covering the entrance to Biron Snowshelf Cave, drop inside, use Bomb Flowers to shatter the three cracked rock plugs draining water into the cave, and open the revealed shrine chest.

Rito_RevaliWeapon.start_zh: 完成前置任务之后和特巴对话后触发，交给他5个木材捆、飞燕弓与3个钻石，完成任务。
Rito_RevaliWeapon.start_en: After completing 'Tulin of the Rito', speak with Teba at the top of Rito Village.
Rito_RevaliWeapon.note_en: Gather a Swallow Bow, 5 bundles of Wood, and 3 Diamonds, then bring them to Teba to craft the legendary bow.
Rito_RevaliWeapon.deliver_zh: 把飞燕弓和材料带给委托人，制作大鹫弓。
Rito_RevaliWeapon.deliver_en: Bring the Swallow Bow, 5 bundles of wood, and 3 diamonds to Teba to craft the Great Eagle Bow.

SaihateSubjugation.start_zh: 到岛上帐篷附近找格玛纳，开始任务
SaihateSubjugation.start_en: Talk to Sesami on the shore of Eventide Island near his campsite tent.
SaihateSubjugation.note_zh: 先去清3个据点，清完回来他会告诉你岛的后面有据点，清完后面据点后再回来交任务即可
SaihateSubjugation.note_en: Wipe out the three monster outposts on Eventide Island, then glide down to the back sea cave behind the island to eliminate the pirate ship crew before reporting back to Sesami.

SearchCaravan.start_en: Speak with Benja at Kara Kara Bazaar looking for his missing caravan partner Ponthos.
SearchCaravan.note_zh: 从流沙掉入沙漠绿洲，然后打破碎石清开一条路。
SearchCaravan.note_en: Drop into the sinkhole whirlpool south of Kara Kara Bazaar to enter the Oasis Source cave. Break through the cracked rocks to find Ponthos and escort him safely to the ladder exit.
reward_zh: 给的宝石用于完成任务「英雄们的秘密」

TakeAnimals.start_zh: 到驿站找陀特茨，老头想见见骨头马
TakeAnimals.start_en: Talk to Toffa at Outskirt Stable, who wishes to see unique wild mounts.
TakeAnimals.note_zh: 夜晚到撒丁公园遗迹，拍摄骨头马的照片并驯服骨头马回驿站，后续任务可以到捕捉骨头马南边的达拉伊特森林，驯服一只鹿骑上回驿站即可
TakeAnimals.note_en: Visit Sanidin Park Ruins at night to tame a Stalhorse (skeletal horse) and ride it back to Toffa. For the follow-up request, tame a wild Mountain Buck in Dalite Forest and ride it to the stable.
reward_zh:
50紫卢比和1点驿站点数
                    后续任务100银卢比和1点驿站点数
reward_en: Follow-up: 100 Silver Rupees and 1 Pony Point

TakeOfIce.start_en: Speak with Anche at the Northern Icehouse north of Gerudo Town.
TakeOfIce.note_en: Create an ice slab using Ice Fruit or a Frost Emitter in the pool, use Ultrahand to trim the ice to fit neatly into the alcove, and present it to Anche.

TheStrongestWeapon.start_zh: 找到恰比聊天触发任务，他因为想做出最强的武器所以需要莱尼尔的角。
TheStrongestWeapon.start_en: Talk to Chabi at the East Akkala Stable road who wants to see the ultimate high-powered weapon.
TheStrongestWeapon.note_zh: 可以提前准备好莱尼尔的角
TheStrongestWeapon.note_en: Fuse a high-tier Lynel Horn (such as a Silver Lynel Horn) onto any weapon and equip it to show Chabi.
reward_zh: 100银卢比   使用白银莱尼尔的角制作的武器可以获得300金卢比。
reward_en: 100 Silver Rupees (300 Gold Rupees if using a Silver Lynel Horn)

TreasureHunt_kokiri.start_zh: 先找到纳末敏触发任务
TreasureHunt_kokiri.start_en: Climb atop the Great Deku Tree's branch in Korok Forest and talk to Walton.
TreasureHunt_kokiri.note_zh: 这个位置要从森林的杂货店旅馆使用两次通天术到达，谜题可以找视频看看
TreasureHunt_kokiri.note_en: Solve Walton's riddles by presenting him with a Forest Dweller's Sword and a Forest Dweller's Spear.

TreasureOfLambda.start_zh: 与洞窟前的多米达克对话开启
TreasureOfLambda.start_en: Talk to Domidak and Prissen standing outside Cephla Lake Cave in Eldin.
TreasureOfLambda.note_zh: 进入洞窟后使用究极手摔宝箱，找到正确宝箱后打开
TreasureOfLambda.note_en: Feed the friendly dog outside the cave until it leads you inside, or use Ultrahand to inspect the buried chests until you dig up the one containing the treasure.

TreasureOfLamda_Dream.name_zh: 拉姆达的财宝 织梦之勇者服1
TreasureOfLamda_Dream.start_zh: 从此处深入洞窟会遇到一块石碑，互动开启
TreasureOfLamda_Dream.start_en: Examine the bottled message inside Cephla Lake Cave after completing 'Misko's Cave of Chests'.
TreasureOfLamda_Dream.note_zh: 位于【古代石柱群的洞窟】，图示1处开启机关，宝箱旁石碑对话开启二阶段，位于【竞技场遗迹】，如图示2将雕像右侧石剑移过来开启机关，石碑对话开三阶段，位于【雷之台地的洞窟】，如图示3开启机关（要求中午）
TreasureOfLamda_Dream.note_en: Head to Ancient Columns Cave in Tabantha. Climb the tall column to step on the pressure switch and open the cave, then claim the chest inside.

TreasureOfLamda_Dream2.name_zh: 拉姆达的财宝 织梦之勇者服2
TreasureOfLamda_Dream2.start_zh: 从此处深入洞窟会遇到一块石碑，互动开启
TreasureOfLamda_Dream2.start_en: Read the stone tablet inside Ancient Columns Cave after obtaining the Tunic of Awakening.
TreasureOfLamda_Dream2.note_zh: 位于【古代石柱群的洞窟】，图示1处开启机关，宝箱旁石碑对话开启二阶段，位于【竞技场遗迹】，如图示2将雕像右侧石剑移过来开启机关，石碑对话开三阶段，位于【雷之台地的洞窟】，如图示3开启机关（要求中午）
TreasureOfLamda_Dream2.note_en: Visit Coliseum Ruins in Central Hyrule. Use Ultrahand to grab the claymore from the right statue and slot it into the hands of the unarmed soldier statue to open Coliseum Ruins Cave.
TreasureOfLamda_Dream2.deliver_zh: 找到地上的士兵双手剑，放到雕像前。
TreasureOfLamda_Dream2.deliver_en: Pick up the Soldier’s Claymore from the ground and place it into the hands of the statue.

TreasureOfLamda_Dream3.name_zh: 拉姆达的财宝 织梦之勇者服3
TreasureOfLamda_Dream3.start_zh: 从此处深入洞窟会遇到一块石碑，互动开启
TreasureOfLamda_Dream3.start_en: Read the stone tablet inside Coliseum Ruins Cave after obtaining the Trousers of Awakening.
TreasureOfLamda_Dream3.note_zh: 位于【古代石柱群的洞窟】，图示1处开启机关，宝箱旁石碑对话开启二阶段，位于【竞技场遗迹】，如图示2将雕像右侧石剑移过来开启机关，石碑对话开三阶段，位于【雷之台地的洞窟】，如图示3开启机关（要求中午）
TreasureOfLamda_Dream3.note_en: Travel to Thundra Plateau in Hyrule Ridge. Around noon (12:00 PM), chop down trees and fuse four logs together to connect the shadow of the south pillar to the north pillar, opening Thundra Plateau Cave.

TreasureOfLamda_DuelPeak.name_zh: 拉姆达的财宝 双子的古代文献
TreasureOfLamda_DuelPeak.start_zh: 从多米达克和布利森兄弟口中得知的古代文献如下：“于西哈特尔并列的双子处有着面对面的兄弟石窟，向哥哥展示弟弟的标志，通往宝物的大门便会打开。”据说只要解开这个谜题就能获得大盗拉姆达的财宝。
TreasureOfLamda_DuelPeak.start_en: Purchase the clue from Domidak and Prissen outside Cephla Lake Cave regarding the twin mountains.
TreasureOfLamda_DuelPeak.note_en: Look at the rock pattern on the ceiling of Dueling Peaks North Cave. Go to Dueling Peaks South Cave and arrange the rocks on the floor switches to mirror the exact pattern of the northern cave.

TreasureOfLamda_FierceDeity.name_zh: 拉姆达的财宝 鬼神装备
TreasureOfLamda_FierceDeity.start_zh: 完成前置任务后，在原宝箱位置会出现一个漂流瓶，互动
TreasureOfLamda_FierceDeity.start_en: Read the message in a bottle inside Cephla Lake Cave after completing 'Misko's Cave of Chests'.
TreasureOfLamda_FierceDeity.note_zh:
第一个位置在【腐朽的千年古树的洞窟】（图示1），一直深入
第二个位置在【阿卡莱堡垒遗迹顶端的洞窟】（图示2），找到该洞窟跳下
第三个位置在【骷髅池塘的洞窟】（图示3），直接深入
完成后穿上装备回到漂流瓶处互动
TreasureOfLamda_FierceDeity.note_en: Retrieve all three pieces: Fierce Deity Boots from Ancient Tree Stump Cave, Fierce Deity Armor from Akkala Citadel Ruins Summit Cave, and Fierce Deity Mask from Skull Lake Cave. Equip all three pieces and return to Cephla Lake Cave to unlock the secret chamber.

TreasureOfLamda_Gerudo.name_zh: 拉姆达的财宝 英雄的古代文献
TreasureOfLamda_Gerudo.start_zh: 与多米达克对话开启3个任务
TreasureOfLamda_Gerudo.start_en: Purchase the Heroines Manuscript from Domidak and Prissen outside Cephla Lake Cave.
TreasureOfLamda_Gerudo.note_zh:
双子：【双子山北边的洞窟】查看谜底（图示1），随后进入【双子山南边的洞窟】开启
英雄：在第八位英雄的雕像旁用镜子反射光开启（图示2）【第八位英雄雕像的内部】，用风扇吹开泥土开启宝箱
海盗：【乌洛克海角崖下的洞窟】吹口哨开启大门（图示3），打烂船上的箱子开启宝箱
TreasureOfLamda_Gerudo.note_en: Head to the colossal Eighth Heroine statue on Gerudo Summit. Use a Mirror to direct sunlight into the statue's chest receptor to open Eighth Heroine Cave, then blow away the sand piles inside to claim the chest.

TreasureOfLamda_Pirate.name_zh: 拉姆达的财宝 海盗的古代文献
TreasureOfLamda_Pirate.start_zh: 从多米达克和布利森兄弟口中得知的古代文献如下：“乌洛克海角眺望哈特尔海，海角之下有一处海盗遗留下来的石窟，用嘴吹出音调，通往宝物的大门便会打开。”据说只要解开这个谜题就能获得大盗拉姆达的财宝。
TreasureOfLamda_Pirate.start_en: Purchase the Pirate Manuscript from Domidak and Prissen outside Cephla Lake Cave.
TreasureOfLamda_Pirate.note_en: Sail or glide into Cape Cales Cliffbase Cave beneath Cape Cales. Stand facing the wooden gate inside and press the down button on the D-pad to whistle, opening the entrance to the pirate ship vault.

Tribune01.start_zh: 找到米荷，他最近因为受到怪物的骚扰而无法专心工作
Tribune01.start_en: Talk to Mihro at Highland Stable, distressed over pirate ships threatening the southern coastline.
Tribune01.note_zh: 清理完船上所有的怪物再回来交任务
Tribune01.note_en: Travel south to Martha's Landing in Faron, eliminate all the monsters aboard the pirate ships, and report back to Mihro.

Uotori_Designer.start_zh: 找到罗莱尔，她正想吃一道料理
Uotori_Designer.start_en: Talk to Ralera in Lurelin Village (or looking out over the water in Hateno Village).
Uotori_Designer.note_zh: 铠甲稠鱼+鼓隆的调味粉+海拉鲁米，还需要提前准备一个风扇机
Uotori_Designer.note_en: Bring Armored Porgy, Goron Spice, and Hylian Rice to cook Seafood Paella, then use a Korok Frond or Zonai Fan to create a cooling gust of wind for her.

Uotori_ResortPlan.start_en: After completing 'Lurelin Village Restoration Project', speak with Rozel and Bolson in Lurelin Village.
Uotori_ResortPlan.note_en: Help establish the water rally minigame by assembling a fan-propelled watercraft and clearing obstacles along the coastal watercourse.

Uotori_WhiteLineGame.start_zh: 先找到水边的基兹塔，跟他交谈触发
Uotori_WhiteLineGame.start_en: Talk to young Zuta near the water in Lurelin Village after liberating the village.
Uotori_WhiteLineGame.note_zh: 箱子不止一个，找到为止就行
Uotori_WhiteLineGame.note_en: Search the shallow bay waters of Lurelin Village using Ultrahand to dredge up sunken iron chests until you open the one containing his father's blue shirt.

WashedAwayBusinessTools.name_en: A Way to Trade, Washed Away
WashedAwayBusinessTools.start_en: Talk to the general merchant Rozel in Lurelin Village about his boat washed out to sea.
WashedAwayBusinessTools.note_zh: 将哈特诺小岛上的船开回沃托里村
WashedAwayBusinessTools.note_en: Travel to Tenoko Island east of Lurelin Village, use Zonai devices or sails to navigate the boat back to the village docks, and talk to Rozel.

WellCollection.start_zh: 进入高原驿站的井中与优诺西塔对话
WellCollection.start_en: Jump down the well at Wetland Stable (or any stable well) to meet Fera, the well enthusiast.
WellCollection.note_zh: 在地图中将所有井全部解锁
WellCollection.note_en: Locate and explore all 58 wells throughout Hyrule. Each newly discovered well earns 10 Rupees from Fera in the Lookout Landing well.
reward_en: 10 Rupees per well discovered (580 Rupees total)

WhichIsStronger.start_zh: 去杂货店找西陀拉聊天开启任务
WhichIsStronger.start_en: Talk to Trissa at High Spirits Produce in Kakariko Village about two quarreling elders.
WhichIsStronger.note_zh: 去西边高台，找到两人之后把周围怪物扫荡干净在去找两人谈话，最后回杂货店交任务
WhichIsStronger.note_en: Head to the plateau west of Kakariko Village, clear out all the monsters surrounding the camp, then speak with the two elderly men before returning to Trissa.

Zonau_GeniusWeapon.name_zh: 于地底发现的“古代之刃”
Zonau_GeniusWeapon.start_en: Speak with the Mining Construct inside the Spirit Temple in the Depths after completing 'Mineru, Sage of Spirit'.
Zonau_GeniusWeapon.note_en: Trade 50 pieces of Zonaite to the Mining Construct in exchange for an Ancient Blade.

ZoraStatue_Picture.start_zh: 先找到塞恭对话开启任务
ZoraStatue_Picture.start_en: Speak with the elder Seggin in Zora's Domain.
ZoraStatue_Picture.note_zh: 在尝试海角坐火到晚上，等到22：00左右拍摄米法雕像和月亮
ZoraStatue_Picture.note_en: Climb to Cape Cales or the designated viewpoint near Shatterback Point around 10:00 PM (22:00) on a clear night, take a photograph of the statue of Mipha bathed in moonlight, and show it to Seggin.

Zora_Enemy_hunt.start_zh: 跟莱阿达对话，得知怪物卓啦的巢穴消息
Zora_Enemy_hunt.start_en: Talk to Dunma at Zora's Domain about a fortified monster stronghold on Ja'Abu Ridge.
Zora_Enemy_hunt.note_zh: 清完所有怪物回去交任务
Zora_Enemy_hunt.note_en: Travel to Ja'Abu Ridge, eliminate all the monsters occupying the fortified camp, and return to report to Dunma.

Zora_MessageBottle.start_zh: 先到卓拉领地的旅馆找柯答聊天开启任务
Zora_MessageBottle.start_en: Talk to Kodah at the inn in Zora's Domain, then find Sasan at the docks.
Zora_MessageBottle.note_zh: 带着萨撒诺一起乘船过去找到菲内即可
Zora_MessageBottle.note_en: Assemble a boat with Zonai devices, ferry Sasan across the water to the Bank of Wishes to reunite him with Finley, and speak to them.

Zora_RuttaTreasure.name_zh: 沉睡于大鱼之下的秘宝
Zora_RuttaTreasure.name_en: Secret Treasure under the Great Fish
Zora_RuttaTreasure.start_zh: 在【卓拉领地】与希多对话开启
Zora_RuttaTreasure.start_en: Speak with Prince Sidon in Zora's Domain after completing 'Sidon of the Zora'.
Zora_RuttaTreasure.note_zh: 在卓拉大桥中央穿过瀑布可以发现【卓拉领地地下的洞窟】，进入后再穿过对面的瀑布即可
Zora_RuttaTreasure.note_en: Head along the Great Zora Bridge, dive down through the waterfall into the Cave under Zora's Domain, navigate through the back waterfall inside the cavern, and open the treasure chest.

gather_Insect_Z.start_zh: 完成前置任务后，与杂货店老板和恩对话触发
gather_Insect_Z.start_en: Speak with the general store merchant Cleff in Zora's Domain after completing 'Sidon of the Zora'.
gather_Insect_Z.note_zh: 精力螃蟹直接可以在老板左侧的池子里或者米法公园到山顶路上抓到
gather_Insect_Z.note_en: Catch 10 Bright-Eyed Crabs (found in the shallow pools around Zora's Domain or along the path to Mipha Court) and deliver them to Cleff.
